Community fitness challenges are emerging as a significant trend in the fitness industry, focusing on group-based competitive activities that drive member engagement and retention. This trend directly impacts TeamBuildr's target market of membership-based gyms, as these challenges can be a key differentiator for independent gym owners looking to build stronger communities and increase member participation.
